section_header: CLUTCH — Check and Adjustment of Clutch Pedal, Bleeding of Clutch System
title: CHECK AND ADJUSTMENT OF CLUTCH PEDAL

content.description: Clutch pedal assembly diagram showing pedal play adjust point, pedal height adjust point, pedal freeplay, pedal height measurement, and asphalt sheet reference

content.text: CHECK AND ADJUSTMENT OF CLUTCH PEDAL

items.text: CHECK THAT PEDAL HEIGHT IS CORRECT AS SPECIFIED

steps: (a) Loosen the lock nut and turn the adjusting bolt until the height is correct.
(c) After adjusting the pedal height, check the pedal freeplay.

items.text: CHECK THAT PEDAL FREEPLAY IS CORRECT AS SPECIFIED
details: Push in on the pedal until initial clutch resistance is felt.
[Push rod play at pedal: 1 – 5 mm (0.04 – 0.20 in.)]

steps: (a) Loosen the lock nut and turn the push rod until the freeplay is correct.
(c) After adjusting the pedal freeplay, check the pedal height.

details: While gently depressing and releasing the pedal, check that engagement and disengagement is smooth.
NOTE: With a pedal stroke of 125 – 135 mm (4.92 – 5.31 in.), the pedal should return in 3 – 4 seconds.

content.text: If any work is done on the clutch system or if air is suspected in the clutch lines, bleed the system of air.
Do not let brake fluid remain on a painted surface. Wash it off immediately.

items.text: FILL CLUTCH RESERVOIR WITH BRAKE FLUID
items.details: Check the reservoir frequently. Add fluid if necessary.

items.text: CONNECT VINYL TUBE TO BLEEDER PLUG
items.details: Insert the other end of the tube in a half-full container of brake fluid.

steps: (a) Slowly pump the clutch pedal several times.
(b) While pressing on the pedal, loosen the bleeder plug until the fluid starts to run out. Then close the bleeder plug.
(c) Repeat this procedure until there are no more air bubbles in the fluid.
